applied.fact: Direction of the peak from the chalet

itinerary.cal: Enchanted Valley is a quota/reservation permit zone; the May 15-Oct 15 season's permits release online on April 15, and bear canisters are required in the valley.

days.note: Hike the East Fork Quinault River Trail from Graves Creek Trailhead (~600 ft) through old-growth rainforest to the historic Enchanted Valley Chalet (~2,035 ft). Grade is gentle and well-graded almost the whole way, with the trail gaining elevation gradually alongside the river. Camp in the quota zone near the chalet, with a view of Chimney Peak's cliffs and waterfalls to the west.
days.title: Approach to Enchanted Valley Chalet
days.objective: Reach the Enchanted Valley Chalet camp

days.note: An alpine-start, out-and-back day climb straight off camp: leave the trail and climb steep, brushy off-trail terrain gaining roughly 4,900 ft in under a mile to reach the SW ridge, then follow class 3 scrambling along the ridge to the 6,917-ft summit. Terrain is notably steep and slide-alder/brush-choked low down (typical of Olympic peak approaches) before opening onto rock near the ridge crest; descend the same way.
days.title: Summit day: SW ridge of Chimney Peak

schedule.label: Alpine start from chalet camp
schedule.detail: Leave most gear in camp; carry a light day pack.

schedule.label: Leave the trail, begin off-trail ascent
schedule.detail: Steep brush and forest low on the SW ridge/drainage.

schedule.label: Break out above brushline
schedule.detail: Terrain opens to class 2-3 rock and heather benches.

schedule.label: Class 3 scrambling to the summit ridge
schedule.detail: Final scramble along the SW ridge crest.

schedule.label: Summit (6,917 ft)
schedule.detail: Views over Enchanted Valley and the Anderson massif.

schedule.label: Descend, back at camp by evening
schedule.detail: Reverse the ridge and brushy drainage; expect a long, tiring descent.

days.objective: Climb Chimney Peak's SW ridge and return to camp

days.note: Retrace the East Fork Quinault River Trail back down to Graves Creek Trailhead. Same easy grade as the approach, just in reverse; tired legs from the summit day make this feel longer than Day 1.
days.title: Hike out

itinerary.totalNote: A 3-day, 2-night backpack: ~27 miles and ~4,000 ft round trip on trail to/from Enchanted Valley Chalet, plus a very steep, brushy ~4,900 ft off-trail class 3 scramble day to the summit and back. Parties wanting a buffer or rest day often stretch it to 4 days.
